verdict.rationale: Fellow offers headless, non-interactive automation through its own REST Developer API. Access uses API keys, with one key recommended per application. Scripts can upload recordings, poll processing status, read transcripts and notes, write agendas, and update action items without the UI. Super Admin keys can act across the whole workspace. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and no published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), so CI use rests on raw REST calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
